description:
Yeji Han suspects she might be getting cheating on. While catching up with her friend Eunji, Yeji shares her worries. Eunji suggests visiting a women-only massage parlor. Shocked at first, she decides to go ahead with the massage. Soohyun's delicate fingers gradually excite her...
